name: ADES Holding Company
summary: ADES Holding Company, through its subsidiaries, provides oil and gas drilling and production services in Egypt, Algeria, Tunisia, the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia, Kuwait, Qatar, India, Southeast Asia, West/Central Africa, Norway, and other regions. Its services primarily include offshore and onshore contract drilling and production services. The company's offshore services comprise drilling and workover services, and a mobile offshore production unit, as well as accommodation, catering, and other barge-based support services.
